name: necromancer-minions-pacified-while-owner-charmed-8284
contract: #8284: Incite Chaos turned the Necromancer army on the group because the minion AI's AttackStart(Unit*)
override only forwarded to ScriptedAI::AttackStart when `!Pacified(player)`, and Pacified() ignored the
owner's charm state. AttackStart is reached natively from Unit::DealDamage -> CreatureAI::OwnerAttackedBy
-> OnOwnerCombatInteraction whenever something lands a hit on the owner, independent of anything the owner
casts, so a charmed owner's existing minions kept joining combat against whoever hit them -- including the
owner's own group. The fix adds `|| player->IsCharmed()` to Pacified(). Reproducing the exact live encounter
(Blackheart the Inciter's 24 s Incite Chaos cast) needs a working dungeon-boss combat/threat/scheduler
cycle that this harness could not be made to engage (the boss's own CreatureAI::JustEngagedWith/scheduler
never started here, independently of this fix, even with a defensive reaction fixture and a direct player
attack). Spell 260 'Charm (TEST)' is Spell.dbc's own generic SPELL_AURA_MOD_CHARM-only test spell
(EffectBasePoints 99+1, no caster/target restriction in Spell::CheckCast's SPELL_AURA_MOD_CHARM block, no
hostility requirement), used here to put the owner into a genuine native Unit::SetCharmedBy(CHARM_TYPE_CHARM)
state from a second player caster -- GetCharmerGUID() becomes non-zero exactly as Incite Chaos's own
33684 would do, so Pacified()'s new `player->IsCharmed()` check is exercised through the identical native
mechanism, independent of the specific charm source. The scenario proves the minion still joins defending
its owner before the charm (baseline, matching the normal, already-working case) and does not join once

steps.label: BASELINE: the owner fights dummy1 (not charmed)
BASELINE: the minion joins defending its uncharmed owner
A second player charms the owner with the DBC's own generic MOD_CHARM test spell
DISCRIMINATING SETUP: the owner is genuinely charmed (native MOD_CHARM -> SetCharmedBy, GetCharmerGUID() non-zero)
A second dummy now hits the charmed owner
Give the native OwnerAttackedBy chain time to fire if it were going to
DISCRIMINATING: the minion does not join combat against whoever hits its charmed owner
